work_en.reading: ハル ワ メグル
work_en.translation_refused: はる in kana is 春, and 春は巡る is the set phrase for spring coming round again; it is also ハル, a given name, and then the title is about a person coming round. Nothing captured settles which: コミック アース・スター's feed carries 【読切】はるは巡る and a byline, and no synopsis. A translation would have to drop one reading to state the other, so ours is the romanisation until somebody reads the one-shot.
